question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom**.

To break loose.
solution:
The correct answer is option 1) i.e. “**To escape**.”

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let’s look at the meaning of the given idiom/ phrase:
 
• The phrase **‘****To break loose****’** means to run away or escape from confinement.
 
• **Example**:
 
 
• ​*The criminal **broke loose** from the prison in the darkness of night.*
 
 
 
• Hence, the only possible answer is option 1 ‘**To escape**’, which exactly resembles the meaning of the given idiom/ phrase.

 

Correct meaning:__ To escape.
